tools.name: charge_room_booking_fee
tools.description: Charges the customer's saved payment method for a paid meeting-room or venue booking, in the given amount and currency. Returns the payment status and payment ID.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the person or team paying for the booking.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Stripe payment method ID to charge.

params.name: booking_reference
params.description: Internal booking reference for the reserved room or venue slot.

params.name: amount_in_minor_units
params.description: Amount to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents).

tools.name: move_event_to_calendar_and_reschedule
tools.description: Moves an event from its current calendar to another calendar and updates its start and end times. Returns the event's new calendar and times.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to move.

params.name: target_calendar_id
params.description: ID of the calendar the event should be moved into.

params.name: new_start_iso
params.description: New start time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-11-10T09:00:00.

params.name: new_end_iso
params.description: New end time in ISO 8601 format; must be after the start.

tools.name: archive_event_and_clear_reminders
tools.description: Moves an event out of the active calendar into the event archive and permanently deletes any pending reminders for it.

params.name: event_id
params.description: ID of the event to archive.

tools.name: file_ics_export_to_folder
tools.description: Moves an exported .ics calendar file from the exports directory into a named subfolder of the calendar export archive. Returns the file's new path.

params.name: export_filename
params.description: Name of the .ics file in the exports directory.

params.name: destination_folder
params.description: Name of the archive subfolder to move the file into, e.g. '2026-Q4'.
